info.name: Recipes API
info.description:
CRUD API for managing recipes (Node.js, Express, Mongoose).

Set the `baseUrl` collection variable (default http://localhost:5000). After running **Create Recipe**, the `recipeId` variable is saved automatically and used by the other requests.

request.description:
Creates a new recipe.

**Required:** title (3–100 chars), ingredients (≥1 `{name, quantity}`), instructions (≥1 string).
**Optional:** description, prepTime, cookTime (minutes), servings (≥1), difficulty (`easy|medium|hard`), category.

response.name: 201 Created
400 Validation Error

request.description: Returns all recipes (newest first). Optional query params: `search`, `category`, `difficulty`, `page` (default 1), `limit` (default 10, max 100).

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Returns a single recipe by its MongoDB ObjectId.

response.name: 200 OK
